minimalPaths.existingService: Use existing UserItemUidReason::Crafting; no new allocator, enum/schema or runtime.rs modifications required.
minimalPaths.helpers: Reuse item_grants::FreshItemGrant and plan_fresh_item_grants. Do not change carrier validators, generic infallible normalize or ordinary custody return.

safeMigrationSteps: Preserve original/current recipe lookup, offered-slot/durability/count checks and the capacity-before-input-consumption ordering. Keep Legacy behavior/default public binding unchanged or separately demonstrate protected old assertions.

Freeze deterministic roll and recipe plan once. Explicitly reject Unavailable/Fenced before a mutable attempt; after validating current input references, refresh_world_history_floor on ORIGINAL live world while every consumed root is still present. Verify configured authority matches; record high consumed material/tool roots before retirement.

Clone InventoryResource. Apply tool damage and ingredient debits to this clone only, preserving UID and metadata on retained/surplus tools or partially consumed stacks. Never pass existing materials/custody through FreshItemGrant.

For a successful chance roll, create a fresh zero-UID prototype using the same current native output defaults (name/description/grade/durability/stats/icon/weight). Keep original carrier validation. Call plan_fresh_item_grants against POST-DEBIT clone, not prepare_world_grants(world), which would read the original inventory.

Post-debit planning is important: if output also matches an ingredient, a fully consumed root must not be reused by prematurely merging output into that original root. Preserve a separate pre-consumption capacity check so freeing an ingredient slot does not make an otherwise forbidden full-bag attempt valid.

On grant/issuer/carrier failure, discard the entire clone and emit only failed CraftItem; do not charge gold, reduce tool durability, remove inputs, publish LoseGold/GainedItem or success. A burned allocated UID prefix may remain retired, but must not appear in any live carrier.

On a valid missed roll, publish staged debit and normal gold charge with successful attempt ack and no gained output. Preserve this original game failure semantics; it is not an issuance/capacity failure. Scan/raise retired input history before publication even on this branch; do not mint a new output UID.

On confirmed valid stage, replace inventory once, apply exact gold charge once, emit all changed output carriers projected from final inventory and final CraftItem result. This remains synchronous in-memory scope; do not add an unverified account-durable receipt claim.
